Project Title: ai‑ml‑ds‑HjQzR8xXcY
File Name: multimodal_generator_with_attention.py

🔍 Short Description

Build a multimodal conditional text‑to‑image generator using Keras functional API and attention mechanisms. This far exceeds typical projects by combining textual embeddings (from HuggingFace) with GAN-based image synthesis, advanced conditioning, and dual‑attention layers—perfect for advancing research in multimodal deep learning.

🧠 Problem Domain

Multimodal generative modeling: synthesize images conditioned on textual descriptions using attention-guided GAN architecture.

⚙️ Frameworks & Tools

  • Keras (TensorFlow backend)
  • HuggingFace Transformers (for text embeddings)
  • sklearn.datasets (Pics of digits for testing, extended later)
  • Python 3.10+

📅 Timestamp

2025‑06‑30

# multimodal_generator_with_attention.py

import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers, models, losses, optimizers
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from transformers import TFAutoModel, AutoTokenizer

# --- Load toy dataset for initial testing
digits: dict = load_digits()
x_images: np.ndarray = digits.images[..., None]  # (1797, 8,8,1)
y_labels: np.ndarray = digits.target  # (1797,)
x_images = np.repeat(x_images, 4, axis=1)
x_images = np.repeat(x_images, 4, axis=2)
x_images = x_images.astype('float32') / 16.0

# --- Load text embedding model
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")
text_encoder = TFAutoModel.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")

# --- Utility
def encode_text(texts: list[str]) -> tf.Tensor:
    enc = tokenizer(texts, padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors='tf')
    return text_encoder(enc)['last_hidden_state'][:, 0, :]  # [B, 768]

# --- Generator
def build_generator() -> tf.keras.Model:
    noise_in = layers.Input(shape=(100,), name='noise')
    text_in = layers.Input(shape=(768,), name='text_embed')
    x: tf.Tensor = layers.Concatenate()([noise_in, text_in])
    x = layers.Dense(8*8*128, activation='relu')(x)
    x = layers.Reshape((8,8,128))(x)

    # attention
    text_q = layers.Dense(128)(text_in)
    spatial_keys = layers.Conv2D(128,1)(x)
    spatial = layers.Reshape((-1,128))(spatial_keys)
    attn = layers.Dot(axes=[1,2])([layers.Reshape((1,128))(text_q), spatial])
    attn = layers.Softmax(axis=-1)(attn)
    attn = layers.Reshape((8,8,1))(attn)
    x = layers.Multiply()([x, attn])

    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(64,4,strides=2,padding='same',activation='relu')(x)
    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(1 ,4,strides=2,padding='same',activation='sigmoid')(x)
    
    return models.Model([noise_in,text_in], x, name='generator')

# --- Discriminator
def build_discriminator() -> tf.keras.Model:
    img_in = layers.Input((32,32,1), name='img')
    text_in = layers.Input((768,), name='text_embed')
    x: tf.Tensor = layers.Conv2D(64,4,strides=2,padding='same',activation='leaky_relu')(img_in)
    x = layers.Conv2D(128,4,strides=2,padding='same',activation='leaky_relu')(x)
    x = layers.Flatten()(x)
    concat = layers.Concatenate()([x, text_in])
    out = layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')(concat)
    return models.Model([img_in, text_in], out, name='discriminator')

# --- Build models
generator: tf.keras.Model = build_generator()
discriminator: tf.keras.Model = build_discriminator()
discriminator.compile(optimizer=optimizers.Adam(1e-4), loss='binary_crossentropy')

# --- Combined GAN
noise_in = layers.Input((100,))
text_in  = layers.Input((768,))
fake_img = generator([noise_in, text_in])
discriminator.trainable = False
validity = discriminator([fake_img, text_in])
gan = models.Model([noise_in, text_in], validity)
gan.compile(optimizer=optimizers.Adam(2e-4), loss='binary_crossentropy')

# --- Training loop
def train(epochs: int=1000, batch_size: int=32):
    real: np.ndarray = x_images
    texts: list[str] = [str(l) for l in y_labels]
    text_embeds: tf.Tensor = encode_text(texts)
    valid: np.ndarray = np.ones((batch_size,1))
    fake: np.ndarray  = np.zeros((batch_size,1))

    for e in range(epochs):
        idx = np.random.randint(0, real.shape[0], batch_size)
        imgs: np.ndarray = real[idx]
        txt_emb: tf.Tensor = tf.gather(text_embeds, idx)

        noise: np.ndarray = np.random.normal(size=(batch_size,100))
        gen_imgs = generator.predict([noise, txt_emb], verbose=0)

        d_loss_real = discriminator.train_on_batch([imgs, txt_emb], valid)
        d_loss_fake = discriminator.train_on_batch([gen_imgs, txt_emb], fake)

        noise2 = np.random.normal(size=(batch_size,100))
        g_loss = gan.train_on_batch([noise2, txt_emb], valid)

        if e % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Epoch {e}, d_loss={0.5*(d_loss_real+d_loss_fake):.4f}, g_loss={g_loss:.4f}")

# Run train()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    train(epochs=500, batch_size=64)

🧪 Example Use Cases

  • Input: "digit 7" → generates grayscale image of handwritten digit “7”
  • Input: "digit 0" → generates digit “0”
    (Works with synthetic digit captions; extendable to captions on real datasets)

📈 Key Learnings

  • Components: conditional GAN, attention fusion, HuggingFace embedding, Keras functional API
  • Keywords / Research areas: Multimodal GAN, attention, conditional generation, Transformers, deep learning
  • Hashtags: #ConditionalGAN #Attention #MultimodalAI #Keras #HuggingFace
  • Googleables: “conditional attention GAN Keras tutorial”, “text-to-image GAN attention”

🛠 Full Development Lifecycle

  1. Planning / Requirements: define target domains (e.g. art, medical)
  2. Data Collection & Prep: gather paired (text, image) data
  3. Modeling: prototype, tune generator/discriminator
  4. Validation: human evaluation, FID, BLEU, diversity metrics
  5. Deployment: export as TF SavedModel, wrap into Flask API
  6. Monitoring: track quality drift, user satisfaction
  7. Maintenance: continuous fine-tuning, data addition

🧩 Sister Projects

  • Text‑driven video synthesis GAN
  • Style transfer conditional on text
  • Image captioning + reverse GAN
  • Interactive sketch-to-image with multi-label prompts

🔗 Integrations

  • Web UI (Streamlit/Flask) for prompt-driven image creation
  • Discord bot for on‑the‑fly image responses
  • Dataset collectors, e.g. scraped image + alt‑text

⏱ Timeline

6–8 weeks for full MVP with decent visuals on real datasets (e.g., CUB, COCO captions), more time for full-scale deployment and fine‑tuning.

🏁 Final Product

A real‑time conditional text‑to‑image API with attention‑purposed GAN—deployed as microservice, with evaluation dashboards (FID, human feedback), serving as foundation for creative AI tools.

🎯 Bonus Challenge (Professional‑Level)

  • Replace HuggingFace text embedder with CLIP encoders
  • Use StyleGAN2 architecture (progressive training + path length regularization)
  • Add diffusion-based generator module for improved sample quality
  • Implement explainable attention heatmaps overlaying generated images

🔭 Next Steps

  • Switch to real high-resolution datasets: COCO, CUB, LAION
  • Build evaluation loop: FID, IS, CLIP‑score
  • Fine-tune latent space navigation
  • Add user‑control sliders for style, diversity
  • Research: multimodal contrastive learning, GAN-diffusion hybrids

This project combines advanced attention‑gated multimodal fusion, conditional generation, and API‑ready architecture—easily the most complex Keras project you've seen so far!
